column1: # Screenshots the wiki shows: a key and its caption, separated by a tab. Each
# picture is public/hop/wiki-data/img/screens/<key>.png. The build fails when a
# page uses a key that is missing here or a listed key is never used.
# Never add a screenshot that shows late-game secrets or the story's ending.

column2: The main menu of a brand-new career. Nana's tutorial unlocks **Play**, **Puzzles** and **Multiplayer**.
With a saved match, **CONTINUE** takes you straight back to the table.
A hand in progress: your rack at the bottom, Rival's face-down rack at the top, scores and perks along the sides.
The same table with **High contrast** and **Large text** switched on.
Picking up a bone shows every place it can go.
Drawing from the boneyard: you choose which face-down bone to take.
The hand setup screen before each hand, where pre-hand supplies and Last Call are used.
The match ledger lists every play, bonus, malus and perk use.
A perk draft. The red card is the Malus. **Reroll** and **Save** come from skills; **Take & Redraw** is the Malus bargain.
The hand summary after a won hand.
The Bone Bucks receipt for a hand.
The XP receipt for a hand.
The **Table Sense** tab of the skill tree.
The **Fortune** tab of the skill tree.
The **House Rules** tab of the skill tree.
The Perks compendium, where you unlock perks for your drafts.
The Supply Shop.
Bone Boxes in the Inventory, with the odds for each rarity printed on the box.
The Slap Track: one reward for every career level.
Cosmetics: table skins.
Cosmetics: domino skins.
The Modes screen early in a career. Locked modes list the career trials that open them.
Custom mode: build your own table rules.
The puzzle list.
A puzzle in progress: a fixed hand, a fixed board and a goal.
The Tutorials menu: Nana's lesson and Rival School.
Nana explaining spinners in her tutorial.
Rival School: one lesson for each of Rival's table styles.
Choosing how to play online.
A private lobby with a friend.
Online standings and leaderboards.
Settings, General tab.
Settings, Animation tab.
The achievements gallery.
